}}'''Hayde''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Wise One]], likely from the [[Daryne]] clan.

== Activities ==
[[Amys]] suggests Hayde and Shanni speed up [[Elenar]]'s training in the hope of sending her to [[Rhuidean]]. Elenar is of the Daryne, so it is assumed that she is training under Wise Ones of her own clan.

It can be assumed that during the [[Last Battle]] she fights in [[Thakan'dar]] Valley along the other Wise Ones.

== Trivia ==
* Hayde is named for Laura Hayden, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
